bottom_line: Financial-market adjustments could have substantial, uneven cross-border effects because global positions are more exposed to valuation changes.

themes.takeaway: Funding and trading are increasingly concentrated.
themes.read: New York Fed evidence shows repo funding is largely overnight and Treasury-backed, while Treasury trading has shifted toward the close, especially at month-end.

themes.takeaway: Cross-border adjustment risks could be uneven.
themes.read: If Fed hikes while Banxico holds, BBVA Research says peso depreciation could follow; BIS says broader rebalancing could create uneven spillovers.
BIS says AI and robots may help only where ageing industries can automate; agriculture and health have less scope than finance.
